allowed_computational_contract.kernel: W(epsilon)=(epsilon+Delta)*sigma_up(epsilon+Delta), positive piecewise linear between source knots; epsilon=E_up-Delta
allowed_computational_contract.reverse: sigma_down(epsilon)=(g_ground/g_upper)*W(epsilon)/epsilon for epsilon>0, with matched shifted finite support
allowed_computational_contract.important_difference: Piecewise linear W is a declared interpolation model. It is not piecewise linear sigma_up and not an independent piecewise-linear fit to raw sigma_down.
allowed_computational_contract.Maxwell_detailed_balance: q_down=(g_ground/g_upper)*exp(Delta/(k_B*T))*q_up for matched kernel/support; evaluate without unstable product where necessary
allowed_computational_contract.outside_support: Finite operator excludes outside-support contributions; no physical zero-tail or continuum source completeness claim
allowed_computational_contract.temperature_domain: No T grid or rate values generated by this source task. Parent must freeze scoped T domain. Mathematical finite Maxwell operator exists for T>0; physical source/interpolation uncertainty separate.

open_obligations: Degenerate LS2s↔2p mixing is formally divergent in CCC README; finite splitting, impact-parameter/plasma cutoff, electron/proton mixing require a separate source contract. Omitted mixing is not a proof of physical insignificance.
High-density quenching/saturation of this selected-star model is a conditional finite-module result until mixing, upper-level ionization, additional excitations and cascades are handled.
No recoil, isotope splitting, fine-structure-dependent excitation operator or transformed physical H line wavelength has been admitted.
No two-photon spectral shape, absorption/stimulated terms, Lyman-alpha reprocessing or cosmological transport follows from the A values.
Finite endpoint and chosenW interpolation give no physical uncertainty enclosure; raw row rounding consistency is distinct from source accuracy.
